rows.name: layer-order
rows.css: @layer first, last; @layer last {@keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}}} @layer first {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}}

rows.name: parent-before-child
rows.css: @layer outer {@keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}} @layer inner {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}}}

rows.name: parent-after-child
rows.css: @layer outer {@layer inner {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}} @keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}}}

rows.name: nested-top-order
rows.css: @layer first,last; @layer last {@keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}}} @layer first.inner {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}}

rows.name: nested-sibling-order
rows.css: @layer outer { @layer first,last; @layer last {@keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}}} @layer first {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}} }

rows.name: implicit-parent-order
rows.css: @layer first.inner {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}} @layer last {@keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}}} @layer first.other {@keyframes pulse {from {width:60px} to {width:60px}}}

rows.name: nested-source-order
rows.css: @layer outer.inner {@keyframes pulse {from {width:80px} to {width:80px}}} @layer outer.inner {@keyframes pulse {from {width:100px} to {width:100px}}}
